_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Integrated Circuit Photomicrograph
summary: The Integrated Circuit Photomicrograph provides a pictorial representation of custom and hybrid ICs to familiarize inspectors with device types unique to a manufacturer's facility, serving as a permanent historical and legal record.
description_purpose: The Integrated Circuit (IC) photomicrograph provides a pictorial representation of custom and hybrid ICs in order to familiarize inspectors with the device types (e.g., topological layout) unique to a particular manufacturer's facility. This data will provide a permanent historical and legal record.
application_interrelationship:
This Data Item Description (DID) contains the format and content preparation instructions for the integrated circuits photomicrographs generated by the specific and discrete task requirement as delineated in the contract.

This data will supplement MIL-STD-883, Method 2010.7.

This DID supersedes DI-E-5312A.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Format.
preparation_instructions.content: The IC photomicrograph shall consist of a negative and an 8" x 10" color photomicrograph of each custom and hybrid IC produced under the contract. Each photomicrograph shall be identified by the applicable drawing number and placed in a protective, transparent cover.

preparation_instructions.title: Content.
preparation_instructions.content: The entire die shall be visible in each color photomicrograph with the following items specifically identified (e.g., items may be marked by arrows and symbols keyed to a separate reference page):

children.title: Metallization tracks (supply voltage, ground, clock, etc.)
Type of wire bond (ultrasonic, wedge, ball bond, etc.), and type of wire (aluminum, gold, etc.).
Tunnel diffusions (cross-overs), contact cuts, and basic chip geometry dimensions.
Geometrically different transistors, including drain, source, and gate electrodes.
Input and output gates, protective diodes, and passive devices.
